regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: “MANUFACTURING MATTERS-NOT ALL TOXINS ARE CREATED EQUAL” | “ENSURE PATIENTS GET THE FULL BENEFITS OF TREATMENT” | “Consistency and efficacy starts with manufacturing. Trust vacuum-dried Jeuveau®, a 900 kDa BoNT/A that utilizes the full complex with active accessory protein for full efficacy.” | “NAPs play an active role in BoNT/A [botulinum neurotoxin type A] activity…” | “BoNT/A with NAPs effectively reduce glabellar strain vs non-complexed formulation”
cases.context: Multiple FDA-approved botulinum toxins for glabellar lines; no head-to-head studies; cited review article only theorizes.
cases.rationale: Suggests manufacturing/formulation gives benefits over other toxins when not demonstrated.
cases.check: Judge: manufacturing/formulation/molecular-weight claims that imply class-comparative clinical advantage without head-to-head data.

cases.claim: “The field effect of the 900 kDa molecule may contribute to the precision profile, supporting the theory larger structures may diffuse less” | “Avoids crystal formation, helping maintain integrity of the toxin, including accessory proteins, for efficacy with less risk of antibody formation.” | “In clinical studies, vacuum-dried toxin formulations produced no antibodies after exposure.”
cases.context: BOXED WARNING on distant spread of toxin effect; PI Immunogenicity section: potential for immunogenicity, cross-study antibody comparisons may be misleading.
cases.rationale: Minimizes distant spread risk and immunogenicity; references don't support.
cases.check: Judge: claims like 'diffuse less' / 'no antibodies' that soften a boxed warning or PI immunogenicity statement.
